openings.claim: Eccentric left pressure elastically twists the hatch. Centered seal contact can coexist with twisting; untreated lateral sliding reflects inadequate restraint.
openings.delta: Change the pressure carrier to a removable strip stiffener lashed solely to the hatch; reversible padded rim clamps supply lateral restraint.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, seal/rim fulcrum rocking, adding stiffness at unchanged bearings and equal left force reduces opposite-corner lift.
openings.probe: Use the shared matched comparison below; defeat this explanation if adequate stiffening leaves lift unchanged.
assumptions: Strip stiffness and secure cord lashing are sufficient; hatch-only attachment adds no rim bearing.
Rim geometry permits removable clamps without damage; neither is supplied.

openings.claim: A raised seal/rim bearing makes the hatch rock diagonally. The compliant seal can mark continuously when centered while permitting rocking and sideways slip.
openings.delta: Change the closure dependency from increasing strap tension to clearance-limited padded strip clamps, keeping the seal and permitting removable bearing adjustment.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, elastic hatch twisting, hatch-only stiffening preserves approximately 2 mm opposite lift under equal left force because the support fulcrum remains.
openings.probe: Use the same comparison; defeat this explanation if stiffening suppresses lift with bearings demonstrably unchanged. Bearing adjustment remains a subsequent proposal, not deployment.
assumptions: An uneven support exists; continuous contact does not establish it.
Available strips can create clearance stops and sufficient lateral restraint within fabrication time.

assessment: Probe two reversible configurations differing only by hatch-only stiffening. Apply matched 20 N left pressure with the scale, recording opposite lift by ruler; bearing invariance and useful stiffness must first be established or discrimination fails. Allocate six closure/pull trials per configuration: five normal checks during ten opening cycles, then one right-card disturbed closure. Measure position, 20 N sideways retention, reopening time and visible seal tears against every supplied target. Bound observation to twenty minutes and fabrication to ninety; capacity is unproven. Remove and cord-bundle all joint pieces when open, leaving the marked opening clear. No powered or permanent changes.
